content_sections.heading: CMD Project Engineer (Civil) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years. Age is counted as on 1 October 2026. Graduation in Civil Engineering from a recognised University. Minimum 3 years of experience in building construction and/or road construction, including Design, Site Supervision, MBook Recording, Bill Preparation and Verification, QC, etc. Proficiency in AutoCAD and PRICE. Only post qualification experience is considered, with 1 October 2026 as the cut-off date. Candidates with Post Graduation in Structural Engineering, Geo Technical Engineering or Construction Management will be given preference. Check the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice does not list fixed selection stages, but it says CMD may send intimation to download call letters for a Written Test, Proficiency Test or Interview through the registered email ID. Applications are scrutinised, and a candidature will be rejected if any lapse is detected, even if the candidate has reached the final stage of recruitment or a later stage.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract is for one year and is extendable based on performance and requirement. CMD reserves the right to fill or not fill the notified post. The rank list is valid for one year from the date of notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMD Project Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check your eligibility against the notification before applying. Prepare a detailed CV and scanned copies of documents proving your age, qualification and experience. Email the CV and scanned documents to [email protected] . Clearly mention the post applied for in both the mail subject and the mail matter. Use a valid personal email ID and mobile number, and keep both active until the recruitment process is complete. A candidate without a valid personal email ID should create one before applying. Detailed CV Scanned proof of age Scanned proof of qualification Scanned proof of experience Incomplete or incorrect email applications, and applications without a detailed CV, will be summarily rejected. Information furnished by a candidate after applying will not be entertained. Candidates must not furnish false, tampered or fabricated information or suppress material information. Candidature will be rejected if the particulars furnished do not tally with the original documents produced. CMD will not be responsible for any discrepancy in submitting the application and CV through email.

faq.question: Q1. Is proof of work experience accepted in the form of pay slips?
faq.answer: No. Copies of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips and similar papers will not be accepted in lieu of a work experience certificate.

faq.question: Q2. What kind of work should the 3 years of experience cover?
faq.answer: It should be in building construction, road construction or both, and include work such as design, site supervision, MBook recording, bill preparation and verification, and QC.

faq.question: Q3. What happened to the earlier CMD notification for this post?
faq.answer: Notification no. CMD/PRJ/002/2026 dated 1 October 2026 stands cancelled.

faq.question: Q4. How will CMD contact applicants about the next stage?
faq.answer: CMD may send intimation to download call letters through the registered email ID.

faq.question: Q5. Can the one-year contract continue after the first year?
faq.answer: Yes, it can be extended, depending on performance and requirement.

faq.question: Q6. Is the rank list used only for this vacancy?
faq.answer: The notice says the rank list stays valid for one year from the date of notification. It does not bind CMD to make an appointment, as CMD may choose not to fill the post.
